problem.paragraph: You put some ice cubes in a glass, fill the glass with cold water, and then let the glass sit on a table. Describe how the temperature of the water changes as time passes. Then sketch a rough graph of the temperature of the water as a function of the elapsed time.

You place a frozen pie in an oven and bake it for an hour. Then you take it out and let it cool. Describe how the temperature of the pie changes as time passes. Then sketch a rough graph of the temperature of the pie as a function of time.

problem.paragraph: In a certain state the maximum speed permitted on freeways is $$65{mi} \slash h$$ and the minimum speed is $$40{mi} \slash h$$ . The fine for violating these limits is $$\$ 15$$ for every mile per hour above the maximum speed or below the minimum speed. Express the amount of the fine $$F$$ as a function of the driving speed $$x$$ and graph $$F(x)$$ for $$0 \leqslant x \leqslant 100$$ .

An electricity company charges its customers a base rate of $$\$ 10$$ a month, plus $$6$$ cents per kilowatt-hour (kWh) for the first $$1200$$ kWh and $$7$$ cents per kWh for all usage over $$1200$$ kWh. Express the monthly cost $$E$$ as a function of the amount $$x$$ of electricity used. Then graph the function $$E$$ for $$0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2000$$ .

In a certain country, income tax is assessed as follows. There is no tax on income up to $$\$ 10,000$$ . Any income over $$\$ 10,000$$ is taxed at a rate of $$10\%$$ , up to an income of $$\$ 20,000$$ . Any income over $$\$ 20,000$$ is taxed at $$15\%$$ .

list.item: Sketch the graph of the tax rate $$R$$ as a function of the income $$I$$ .

exercises.instruction: 77–78 Graphs of $$f$$ and $$g$$ are shown. Decide whether each function is even, odd, or neither. Explain your reasoning.

problem.paragraph: 77. Details Two curves are graphed on the x y coordinate plane. The curve labeled f enters the top left of the viewing window in the second quadrant, goes down and to the right, concave up, crosses the negative x axis, reaches a low point in the third quadrant, goes up and to the right through the origin, becoming concave up, reaches a high point in the first quadrant, goes down and to the right, crosses the positive x axis, and exits the bottom right of the viewing window in the fourth quadrant. The curve labeled g resembles W-shape and is symmetric about the y axis. It enters the second quadrant to the right of the curve f, goes down and to the right, concave up, reaches its first low point in the second quadrant, goes up and to the right, now concave down, reaches a high point on the positive y axis, then mirrors its earlier path, reaching its second low point in the first quadrant, directly across the first low point, and then goes up and to the right. $$f$$ is odd, $$g$$ is even

The curve labeled g enters the third quadrant from the left, goes down and to the right, concave up, reaches its first low point in the third quadrant, goes up and to the right, now concave down, reaches its first high point in the third quadrant, then goes down and to the right, becoming concave up again, reaches its second low point on the negative y axis, mirrors its earlier path by rising to the second high point and falling to the third low point.
